question: A train travelling at a speed of 45 km/h crosses a house in 12 sec. What is the length of the train?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Speed of train = 45 km/h x 5/18 = 12.5 m/s

Length of train = 12.5 m/s x 12 sec. = 150 m

**∴ Length of train is 150 m.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Given:

Speed in train = 45 km/h

Time = 12 sec.

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed x Time 

**Concept used:**

1 km = 1000 m

1 hour = 3600 sec

**Calculation:**

Speed of train = 45 km x 1000 m/3600 sec

⇒ 45 km/h x 5/18

⇒ 12.5 m/s

Now,

Length of train = Train cover the distance in 1 second.

⇒ 12.5 m/s x 12 sec

⇒ 150 m

∴ Length of train is 150 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**If Convert km/h to m/s = km/h x 5/18

and if convert m/s to km/h = m/s x 18/5.
